message:
CAP_AM meets Monday/Wednesday, 8:00–9:15 a.m.; CAP_ALT meets Tuesday/Thursday, 8:00–9:15 a.m. Each is 4 credits, so either schedule totals 12 credits, within your required 12–16.

CAP_ALT is feasible: it fulfills CAP4000, you meet its CS3000 prerequisite, one seat is available, and it conflicts with neither your other courses nor your Tuesday/Thursday noon–5 p.m. work hours. Neither section meets your afternoon preference, which is a preference rather than a hard rule.

Your approved schedule—KEEP_A, KEEP_B, and CAP_AM—remains unchanged. No changes were proposed or made.
